children: Exelixis announced the Federal Circuit affirmed that three U.S. patents are not invalid, blocking earlier FDA approval of a challenger’s ANDA until at least January 15, 2030.
Federal Circuit affirmed district court that U.S. Patents 11,091,439; 11,091,440; 11,098,015 are not invalid.
Court dismissed as moot appeal on Patent 11,298,349 and vacated that portion of the district court decision.
Per opinion, FDA final approval of MSN’s ANDA cannot be earlier than Jan 15, 2030, subject to appeals, exclusivity, and separate Patent 12,128,039 litigation.
Trial on Patent 12,128,039 is scheduled for November 2026; outcome could affect timing of any generic launch.

title: Exelixis wins appeals court ruling upholding key patents, FDA approval barred until at least Jan 15, 2030
